source.text: A case with one fault: a run that starts from the steady state of its boundary whose history begins at a different boundary, so the start would not be steady. FEED must refuse it before any run; SEED reports E_TRANSIENT_INCOMPLETE.
source.check: FEED's schema vectors (schema/vectors/bad/boundary-history-steady-start-differs.json) assert the same code in FEED's own test suite.
